DRAFTMANGO / LEGAL

Terms & privacy

The ground rules for using Draftmango, how your information is handled, and who to contact.

25 October 2026 · Version 1.0 · Launch preview

At a glance
  • Draftmango is operated by DROPCIRCLE LTD, registered in England and Wales.
  • You keep the rights to your content. Review AI output and third-party licences before using it.
  • Paid plans and domain registration are not live yet. Static-site publishing is available for restricted account testing.

Terms of service

Version 1.0 · Effective 25 October 2026

These terms cover the Draftmango website, builder workspace and related preview features. “We”, “us” and “our” mean DROPCIRCLE LTD. “You” means the person using Draftmango or the organisation they are authorised to represent. By using the service, you agree to these terms. Our privacy notice separately explains how we handle personal information.

1. What Draftmango provides

Draftmango is a website-building workspace that brings conversation, editable source files, browser previews and project management together. In enabled workspaces, you can submit AI requests, make manual changes, save work to your account and export project files. Features depend on the services enabled for your workspace.

The public site is currently a launch preview. Public registration, live paid subscriptions, domain purchases and CLI access are not open. Static-site publishing is enabled for restricted account testing. A preview, saved domain draft or pricing selection does not publish a website, register a domain or complete a payment. See current availability.

2. Accounts and access

The service is intended for people aged 18 or over. You must provide accurate account information and have authority to act for any organisation you represent. Keep your password secure, use only accounts you are authorised to access and tell us if you suspect misuse. Verification and password recovery depend on email delivery being available.

Do not put passwords, API keys, payment-card numbers or sensitive personal records into prompts, attachments, project files or shared links. Account passwords belong only in the dedicated account forms. Keep your own copies of important work.

3. Your content and generated work

You retain the rights you already have in content you supply, including prompts, code, images and text. You must have permission to use it and to ask us to process it. You give us a limited, non-exclusive permission to store, display, process and transmit that content as needed to provide the features you request, including sending relevant context to an enabled AI provider.

We do not claim ownership of your input or generated project output. To the extent we have transferable rights in output generated for you, we assign those rights to you. This does not establish copyright in material that is not eligible for it, make output exclusive, or grant rights in another person’s work. You may use your exports for personal or commercial projects, subject to applicable law and third-party licences.

Draftmango’s own name, interface, branding and underlying service remain ours or our licensors’. Fonts, images, dependencies and other third-party materials retain their separate licence conditions. Review them before distribution. Permission to build a website does not imply permission to use someone else’s brand or content.

4. AI, previews and exports

AI results can be inaccurate, incomplete, insecure or similar to someone else’s output. Review and test generated files, factual claims, accessibility and licensing before relying on them. We do not guarantee a particular model, unique designs or a successful result from every request.

A page that visually contains a payment form, login screen or store does not acquire a working backend merely by being generated. Browser previews and exported HTML are development tools; a source ZIP is a copy of project files. You remain responsible for the hosting, security, transactions and privacy notices of a separate site you launch. Draftmango’s privacy notice does not automatically cover that site’s visitors.

5. Acceptable use

Use Draftmango lawfully and respect other people’s rights. You must not use it to:

  • Distribute malware, steal credentials, gain unauthorised access or bypass service security and usage limits.
  • Run fraud, phishing, unlawful impersonation or deceptive data collection.
  • Infringe intellectual-property, confidentiality or privacy rights.
  • Facilitate child exploitation, non-consensual intimate imagery, unlawful threats or other illegal abuse.
  • Disrupt the service or represent a simulated purchase, connection or deployment as a real completed action.

This does not restrict lawful, authorised security testing or rights that cannot legally be limited. Report harmful content or a security concern using our contact details, identifying the relevant page without sending unnecessary sensitive information.

6. Plans, credits and payments

The pricing page describes proposed launch plans. Selecting one does not create a paid subscription or charge you. Credit allowances and charging rules are not active in the current preview. Preview build and test activity is not a bill. Manual source editing and browser previews do not consume AI credits.

Before paid services open, checkout will need to state the final amount and currency, applicable taxes, billing period, renewal, cancellation, credit expiry and refund conditions. A purchase requires your express confirmation. No payment obligation or automatic renewal is created by reading these terms. Changes to existing paid commitments will require the notice and consent applicable law requires.

We do not impose a blanket “no refunds” rule. Statutory consumer cancellation, refund and faulty-service rights remain intact. Where a paid digital service requires agreement to start during a cancellation period, that agreement and any acknowledgement of its effect must be requested separately; accepting these terms alone is not a waiver. Contact us about any charge you do not recognise.

7. Domains and hosting

Static websites can be published to a Draftmango subdomain where account access is enabled. The Free plan allows one active published website. Paid plans are intended to permit connecting an existing custom domain or buying one separately through Draftmango. A plan price does not include buying or renewing a custom domain. Registration and renewal quotes may include a Draftmango service margin; the total price must be shown before a purchase is confirmed.

Current domain search and order flows are previews or sandbox operations. Availability can change and is not a reservation. No ownership, DNS change, renewal, transfer or hosting service is created by saving a draft. Before live registration, we will provide the applicable registrar terms, customer details required for registration, total charges and renewal settings for approval. Cancelling a website plan must not be assumed to cancel a separately purchased domain.

Publishing makes a saved copy of supported HTML, CSS, JavaScript and related public assets available to anyone with the website address. Later draft edits remain private until you publish again. You can restore an available release or unpublish; unpublishing does not remove copies visitors or search engines already hold. Server-side code, custom-domain activation, an uptime service-level agreement and a managed security guarantee are not currently provided.

8. Third-party services

Enabled AI processing and external resources involve other providers, as described in the privacy notice. Importing a public GitHub repository copies supported source files; it does not grant private-repository access or execute a backend. Separately connected services and sites you visit have their own terms. A provider logo is not a statement that its integration is enabled or that it endorses Draftmango.

9. Saving, suspension and deletion

Check save and connection status before leaving the workspace. Browser working copies are not independent backups. You can export work and use the available project or account deletion controls. Clearing browser data does not delete cloud records. Help explains the difference.

You may stop using the preview at any time. We may restrict access to address unlawful activity, security risks or a material breach, and may change or withdraw preview features. Where reasonably practical, we will explain significant changes and allow time to export your work. Immediate action may be necessary to protect the service or other people. You may contact us to challenge a restriction.

10. Responsibility and your legal rights

Preview features may contain bugs and may not meet every requirement. We do not promise uninterrupted availability or a particular result. This does not exclude responsibility that the law places on us.

Nothing in these terms limits liability for fraud, fraudulent misrepresentation, death or personal injury caused by negligence, or anything else that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited. Your statutory consumer rights remain in place, including remedies for services or digital content that do not meet applicable legal standards. Where consumer law applies, we remain responsible for losses for which that law makes us responsible.

11. Changes, complaints and governing law

The effective date appears above. We will make updated terms available and explain material changes before they take effect where reasonably possible. Changes do not retrospectively authorise new charges or unrelated uses of your content. Processing that requires consent requires a separate valid choice.

Contact DROPCIRCLE LTD using the details below so we can address a concern. These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales. Its courts may hear disputes, without removing a consumer’s right to mandatory protections or courts available in their country of residence.

Privacy notice

Version 1.0 · Updated 26 October 2026

DROPCIRCLE LTD is the controller responsible for personal information used to operate Draftmango. This notice covers our public website and, where access is enabled, accounts and the builder workspace. It does not replace the privacy notice needed for a separate website published by a user, whether hosted on Draftmango or exported elsewhere. Company and contact details appear below.

Current service status

The public site is a launch preview. Public registration, live AI access, payments, domain purchases and transactional email are not enabled on this deployment. The workspace descriptions below explain the data handled when those features are available in restricted testing; they do not mean every visitor has access to them.

Information we handle

  • Website requests: connection information such as IP address, browser headers and requested addresses is processed to deliver and protect the site. Errors can create diagnostic records. Routine access logging is disabled for application requests at the public proxy and backend.
  • Accounts: email address, display name, hashed password, verification status, account dates, preferences and session records. Session records can include browser/device information and sign-in time. We do not store your account password as readable text.
  • Your workspace: prompts, conversations, project names, source files, revisions, selected references, attachments and project notes. Saved project records are associated with your account. A working copy is also kept in your browser.
  • Activity: event type, associated project identifier, time and success status for workspace actions. These activity records do not themselves contain prompt text, source code or test output, although that content can exist separately in your saved project.
  • Domain drafts: selected names, quoted prices and connection or order-preview details are kept on your device. An enabled search sends the domain names you request to the registrar’s search API.
  • Correspondence: information you choose to send when asking for help, reporting a problem or exercising a right. Avoid sending passwords, full card details or unnecessary identity documents.

Information generally comes from you, your browser and your use of the workspace. Repository imports also obtain selected public files from GitHub. You can browse the public information pages without an account. Account details are needed to provide saved-workspace access; optional prompts and references are needed only for the actions you request.

Why we use it

We use account and project information to provide the service you request, including saving work, authenticating access and processing submitted tasks. For processing necessary to perform our agreement with you or take requested steps before it, the UK GDPR basis is contract.

Delivering the public site, diagnosing faults, preventing abuse, securing accounts and handling ordinary support enquiries rely on our legitimate interests in running a reliable service, balanced against your rights. We use information to meet applicable legal obligations, including responding to valid privacy requests. If an optional use requires consent, we will request it separately. Accepting terms is not consent to marketing or unrelated uses.

Draftmango has no advertising-network or behavioural-analytics integration and does not sell personal information. We do not operate a model-training pipeline using customer projects.

AI and other providers

Hosting: our application and database run on a Hostinger VPS. Hostinger provides the underlying infrastructure. Cloudflare supplies our domain registration and DNS; the site currently uses DNS-only records, so normal application traffic goes directly to our hosting server rather than through Cloudflare’s proxy.

AI, when enabled: submitting a task sends the prompt, relevant conversation context, project source, instructions and supported references to the configured model provider. OpenAI is the selected provider for our current testing. The integration can also support Anthropic or xAI if configured. We will identify the active service before making new provider choices available. Do not include material you are not authorised to share.

Our OpenAI integration requests that Responses API results are not stored as retrievable responses. That setting is not a promise of zero retention: a provider may still keep information for security or other purposes under its agreement. Provider retention and training practices depend on the applicable provider terms and settings. We do not promise exclusive output or that no provider ever retains a request.

Other integrations: public repository import requests go to GitHub. Name.com is the selected domain-search and registration integration, currently limited to development/sandbox use. Stripe is the planned payment processor, with no live checkout currently enabled. Social sign-in, transactional email delivery and CLI pairing are not enabled on the public deployment. We will update the relevant data flows before activating them.

External images, fonts or links in a generated preview can cause your browser to contact their providers, who receive normal connection information. Content you export or share is also handled by recipients and services you choose. We may disclose necessary information to advisers or authorities where a lawful obligation or legitimate legal need requires it.

International processing: hosting and integration providers operate internationally. We do not represent that all information remains in the UK. Where a restricted transfer is involved, applicable transfer requirements must be met, such as an adequacy decision or appropriate contractual safeguards. The public preview does not offer a choice of data-residency region. Contact us for the locations and safeguards applicable to your use; provider and transfer arrangements will be reviewed before opening account and AI access publicly.

Published websites: publishing stores a public snapshot of supported website files separately from the private draft. Conversations, workspace notes and account details are excluded from that snapshot. Website source may itself contain information you choose to publish, so review it first. Up to 20 releases are retained for rollback. Unpublishing removes public access on subsequent requests; deleting the account removes its stored releases. Used subdomain names remain reserved to prevent a new owner inheriting an old website origin. Public hosting does not currently keep access logs, although error and operational records may be retained for troubleshooting.

Cookies and browser storage

We use storage for requested account and workspace functions. We do not currently set advertising or analytics cookies. Optional non-essential tracking, if introduced, will require the choices and information applicable law requires.

Storage used by the current application
ItemPurpose and duration
__Host-draftmango_sessionAuthenticates an account. The default lifetime is 14 days; signing out revokes the session. Secure and HttpOnly on the public HTTPS service.
__Host-draftmango_csrfHelps prevent forged requests. Default browser lifetime is approximately one year and it can be refreshed. Secure and HttpOnly on HTTPS.
Local storageAccount-scoped working copies, preferences and domain drafts, plus interface and session-change state. Remains until cleared or removed by the relevant control; there is no general automatic expiry.
Session storageUnsubmitted workspace prompts and temporary navigation state. Normally ends when the tab session ends; submitted drafts may be removed sooner.

Blocking necessary cookies prevents sign-in. You can remove cookies and site data in your browser. This does not delete account records on the server, exported files, browser history or copies held by recipients. Signing out is not the same as erasing all saved browser data; clear site data on shared devices.

Starting an idea from the homepage can put its text in the address after a #. That fragment is not sent in the initial HTTP request, but page scripts can read it and submit it to the workspace, and it can remain in browser history or a copied link. Never put secrets in an idea or share a link without checking it.

Retention and deletion

Account and saved-workspace data is kept while needed to provide your account, unless you delete it or ask us to do so. There is no automatic inactivity-deletion schedule in the current preview. Project history has application size limits and is not an unlimited archive. Browser records remain according to the controls described above.

Account deletion removes the active profile, saved chats and projects, preferences and activity, and revokes active sessions. Pending or active billing commitments, if enabled later, must be resolved before the account-deletion control can proceed; you can still contact us about your privacy rights. Files you downloaded and records on another device are not remotely erased.

Diagnostic records, recovery copies and legal correspondence can outlast active records. We keep these only for the relevant fault investigation, recovery, legal obligation or dispute, taking account of its resolution and applicable limitation periods. The preview does not have a uniform time-based log or backup expiry or promise immediate removal from all recovery copies. Deletion requests must include review of copies we control; if a copy is restored, relevant deletions must be reapplied. Contact us for the applicable retention information.

Security and your choices

We use HTTPS, password hashing, account ownership checks and revocable sessions. These measures do not eliminate every risk. Protect your device and email account, and use the session controls in Settings → Security to end unwanted access.

Settings → Data & privacy offers an account export and deletion. Usage provides a separate activity export. An account export includes saved source and conversations, so review it before sharing it. It excludes authentication passwords and service credentials; a secret you put in your own source or messages may still be included.

Your privacy rights

Depending on the law and legal basis involved, you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or a portable copy of your personal information. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests on grounds relating to your circumstances, and to direct marketing at any time. Where we rely on consent, you may withdraw it without affecting earlier lawful processing.

Use our contact details, marked “Draftmango — Data Protection”. We may need proportionate information to verify your request. We will respond within the applicable legal deadline and explain any lawful limitation or extension. You may complain directly to the UK Information Commissioner’s Office or your relevant supervisory authority without first complaining to us.

Children, automated decisions and updates

Draftmango is intended for adults aged 18 or over and does not currently perform age verification. Do not submit children’s personal information. The service generates project content; it does not use your information to make solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on you.

We will update this notice when processing changes, explain material changes appropriately, and obtain any consent required before a new optional use begins. The date and version identify this notice. You can print or save it using your browser.
